how_to.booking: Nothing to book: create a free IU account and pass the challenges at your own pace.
how_to.results_time: Credential awarded when all challenges for the version are passed.

new.title: OSHA 10 (General Industry)
new.reason: ~$59 and 10 contact hours; plant-floor safety awareness that entry controls/tech postings ask for, finishable in 2 days (vs OSHA 30, moved to LATER).

how_to.format: Online self-paced course from an OSHA-authorized online provider (General Industry 10-hour: 360Training/OSHAcampus, AdvanceOnline, CareerSafe, ClickSafety, HSI, PureEHS, University of South Florida). OSHA limits training to 7.5 contact hours/day. ClickSafety: complete within 180 days of start; final exam 40 questions, 70% minimum, 3 attempts. An OSHA card is not a certification or license.
how_to.cost_note: OSHA sets no price; trainer fees vary. ClickSafety OSHA 10-Hour: $59.00 (listed as a sale price).
how_to.booking: Enroll directly with an authorized provider; self-paced. Verify the provider is on OSHA's list before paying.
how_to.results_time: Not same-day for the card: OSHA requires trainers to issue the card within 90 days of completion. ClickSafety: printable certificate right after the final exam + course evaluation; plastic DOL card shipped within two weeks.
